title: The Market of a Thousand Things

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A trader imagines a distant marketplace where buyers can choose from more goods than anyone could carry.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A trader imagines a distant marketplace where buyers can choose from more goods than anyone could carry.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children invent shelves of unfamiliar fruit, fabrics, tools, and toys.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A craftsperson wonders whether too many choices would make a simple purchase exhausting.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers compare barter, shared stores, promises, and tokens of value.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The trader points out that an object can be plentiful yet inaccessible to someone without resources.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A gardener proposes preserving, repairing, and redistributing unused goods.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The group imagines mountains of waste and becomes uneasy about abundance without restraint.
